script.spoken: This product has no test report yet.
The site says so, on the product page, in writing.
Reports are filed per batch, not per product. A product without one is marked pending rather than given a placeholder figure.
That is the whole policy. Read it yourself.

concepts.hook: That white disc at the bottom of the vial is not powder that settled.

concepts.opening_frame: Extreme macro on the white cake inside the vial, shot through the glass, already pushing in slowly. The disc fills most of the frame. No face, no logo, no title card.

script.spoken: That white disc at the bottom of the vial is not powder that settled.
It is a cake. The compound was frozen in solution, then the ice was drawn off under vacuum as vapour, without ever passing through liquid.
What is left holds the shape the liquid had. That is why it looks moulded rather than poured.
It is also why the label says store at two to eight degrees. The structure is the point.
Lyophilized. It is printed on every vial we ship.

shot_list.shot: EXTREME MACRO, slow push. The cake through glass, its porous surface and the shadow it throws inside the vial. Deep focus, dark field.
MACRO, slow lateral drift across the cake's edge where it meets the glass wall, showing the shrink gap. Cool key from behind.
MEDIUM, locked off. Full vial upright, matte charcoal plinth, backlit so the cake reads as a solid mass rather than loose powder.
MACRO, locked off. The printed storage line on the label, square to camera, unchanged angle, only the small print in frame.
MEDIUM WIDE, slow pull back into negative space. CTA sets in the lower-middle third.

concepts.visual_direction: Dark matte laboratory, brand.md palette. Background #0a0a0a pure neutral, gold confined to a single thin edge highlight on the crimp seal. Glass, not gold. No beakers, no gloved hands, no pipettes, no glowing liquid: this is the object under a light, not stock-photo science.
